Small business owners may have a good product and a phone, but choosing and adapting a trend requires marketing judgment. The survey establishes the customer-acquisition problem; it does not prove demand for TrendForge. Source: https://www.constantcontact.com/news/2025-03-04-new-wave-of-smbs-is-social-first-technology-driven-and-highly-adaptable . Published March 4, 2025. Survey of 1,600 businesses operating for five years or less across the US, UK, Australia and Canada. 52% identified customer acquisition as their top marketing challenge.

Additional source: https://www.constantcontact.com/news/2025-09-03-the-state-of-small-business-marketing-effort-is-up-while-confidence-has-declined . Published September 3, 2025; survey conducted June 2025 by Ascend2 Research, 2,500 small business decision-makers across Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States. 42% reported less than one hour per day to spend on marketing. This is all marketing time, not video-production time. Do not combine denominators across the two surveys.

This is a use case, not a customer success story. A jewelry seller has a new necklace and wants store visits. They need a relevant format and practical filming instructions. The same workflow could apply to other small businesses marketing a physical product. The image was generated for illustration using OpenAI image generation and is not evidence of a customer or a real event.

Source: https://www.constantcontact.com/news/2026-06-10-the-rise-of-the-smb-creator-how-small-businesses-are-leveraging-social-media-and-ai-to-capture-consumer-attention . Published June 10, 2026. Consumer sample: 2,255 across US, UK, Canada and Australia/New Zealand. 49% use social media to discover new small businesses. This is discovery behavior, not a purchase rate or a claim that TrendForge increases sales.

Demo flow: select a trend, inspect its analysis, enter a product brief, generate a shot-by-shot filming guide, and upload a draft for specific feedback. Keep the demo focused on the human filming workflow. AI writes the plan, but generating a video is not required. Product capabilities are supported by the project implementation in lib/analysis.ts and lib/viral.ts; do not imply that suggestions guarantee sales or virality. During a live demo, show one useful instruction and one concrete draft improvement.

Specific improvement points to demonstrate: varied product shots instead of one continuous sales pitch; readable offer or call-to-action text; specific draft feedback on pacing and brand integration. These correspond to the existing film-guide and draft-review capabilities, not a new claim of automated sales tracking.

Source: TikTok, Dec 2021 · Paid-ad associations, not additive or guaranteed · Not TrendForge results

Business goal: more sales from less content effort. External evidence supports concrete creative improvements, not a claim of proven TrendForge lift. Source: https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en-US/blog/creative-that-drives-conversions . Published December 21, 2021. TikTok used a machine-learning model to analyze thousands of auction-platform ads. Ecommerce section: varied scenes were associated with 38% conversion lift compared with one person selling a product in one continuous shot. Ecommerce videos using captions or on-screen text clearly displaying an offer or CTA showed 80% conversion lift compared with videos without text or CTA. Historical platform-reported paid-ad associations; not randomized causal estimates, not organic-post forecasts, and not revenue-growth percentages. These lifts must not be summed or multiplied. The article gives no exact sample count or confidence intervals. TrendForge can support shot planning and on-screen text, but its revenue impact remains unvalidated. Proposed pilot: compare multiple comparable usual and assisted posts for each business, controlling or recording offer, posting time, spend and audience. Record time spent; use campaign links/codes and store analytics for visits and orders. Sales tracking is a pilot measurement plan, not an implemented TrendForge capability. Consider contribution margin and content/tool costs before claiming profit gains.
